en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with horse‑drawn wagons and wooden houses. On the left stands a corner building with a small tower and a sign in Cyrillic and French reading "Гостиница Руссиа / Hotel de Russie." The street extends into the distance between trees and low buildings. Printed in red at the bottom margin is the caption "Werro. Dörptsche Strasse."
